newsitem.title: CHINA: Cambodia's King Sihanouk says abdication rejected.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia's King Sihanouk says abdication rejected.

text.p: Cambodia's King Sihanouk said on Wednesday that his offer to abdicate had been refused by Second Prime Minister Hun Sen but said his decision to return soon to his homeland had been welcomed.

In a meeting at Sihanouk's residence in Beijing on Tuesday, the visiting Cambodian strongman had not accepted the king's offer to abdicate during the current political crisis in their homeland, Sihanouk said in a statement.

"This delegation -- in particular his excellency Hun Sen -- assured N. Sihanouk of its fidelity and its support for the king whose offer to abdicate it did not accept," Sihanouk said in the statement faxed to news agencies.
"(This delegation) expressed its infinite gratitude for the royal decision to return to Cambodia in the near future," said Sihanouk, who is in Beijing for medical treatment.
He said he had no plans for another meeting with Hun Sen after holding five hours of talks on Tuesday. Hun Sen is expected to leave for home on Thursday.
